execution_invariant: Each cycle must close a gate, create a verified artifact, make a measured change, strengthen a reference decision, or retire redundant work.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: giving coding agents increasing repository/tool authority without sacrificing reviewability, intent alignment, or developer trust

lead_innovation.name: Patch Intent Twin
lead_innovation.mechanism: Maintain a machine-readable twin of the requested change—requirements, forbidden surfaces, architectural constraints, expected tests—and continuously compare the evolving patch against that intent.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: balancing general humanoid capability with manufacturability, serviceability and fast customer integration

lead_innovation.name: Deployment Interface Standardizer
lead_innovation.mechanism: Define reusable physical/workcell contracts—fixtures, handoff zones, safety fields, task APIs—so each new factory does not become a bespoke robotics integration project.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: capturing more AI compute value while workloads fragment across CPU, accelerator, mobile, edge and datacenter execution

lead_innovation.name: Cross-ISA AI Placement Contract
lead_innovation.mechanism: Expose portable workload descriptors that let runtimes choose CPU/vector/accelerator execution by latency, energy, memory locality and privacy, making Arm systems a coherent heterogeneous target.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: maintaining coherent high-bandwidth connectivity as accelerator/memory topologies become larger and increasingly dynamic

lead_innovation.name: Fabric Congestion Autopilot
lead_innovation.mechanism: Expose fine-grained link/queue telemetry to a topology controller that remaps traffic and memory attachment around congestion/failures before application throughput collapses.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: turning massive trace volume into the smallest high-value set of evals that predicts real production failures

lead_innovation.name: Eval Portfolio Optimizer
lead_innovation.mechanism: Treat eval cases like an investment portfolio: maximize failure-class coverage and predictive power under a fixed evaluation budget; retire redundant cases and upweight emerging failure clusters.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: serving exploding AI telemetry/traces economically while supporting increasingly stateful, high-cardinality agent analysis

lead_innovation.name: Trajectory-Native Storage Layout
lead_innovation.mechanism: Physically cluster spans, tool calls, evals and costs by agent trajectory plus time so full-session forensic queries avoid expensive distributed joins.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: reliably carrying software tasks across long horizons where environment setup, hidden dependencies, ambiguous requirements, and partial failures compound

lead_innovation.name: Execution Checkpoint Lattice
lead_innovation.mechanism: Persist verified intermediate states and reversible checkpoints keyed to task subgoals, so the agent can branch, compare, and recover without repeating entire trajectories.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: co-optimizing rack-to-model performance as inference becomes a major workload and energy/network constraints shape economics

lead_innovation.name: Rack-to-Token Autopilot
lead_innovation.mechanism: Close the loop from model latency/throughput back through GPU placement, network topology, power caps, thermals, and batching to maximize successful tokens/tasks per constrained rack.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: converting architectural specialization into a durable advantage as model architectures evolve and general accelerators improve

lead_innovation.name: Architecture Exposure Hedge
lead_innovation.mechanism: Maintain a compiler-level compatibility model that quantifies revenue/performance exposure to attention, MoE, state-space and multimodal architecture shifts; prioritize hardware/software adaptations before the dominant workload changes.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: scaling from successful industrial deployments to broader tasks while preserving uptime, dexterity, safety and cost

lead_innovation.name: Fleet Skill Compounding Engine
lead_innovation.mechanism: Cluster successful and failed fleet trajectories into reusable skill primitives; validate a skill across robot/unit/site variation before fleet-wide promotion.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: pushing latency/throughput while ensuring aggressive kernel and quantization optimization does not create customer-specific quality regressions

lead_innovation.name: Optimization Safety Envelope
lead_innovation.mechanism: Every serving optimization carries an eval delta budget by workload class; auto-canary variants and roll back when latency gains exceed allowed behavioral drift.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: differentiating GPU access when raw capacity increasingly commoditizes and customers care about reliable cluster performance and time-to-useful-compute

lead_innovation.name: Useful-GPU-Minute Contract
lead_innovation.mechanism: Meter and optimize time from allocation to productive model work, including provisioning, failures, network stalls, storage load, and job retries—not just rented accelerator time.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: keeping a broad integration surface coherent while giving production users strong semantics for state, durability, evaluation, and version compatibility

lead_innovation.name: Typed Agent Capability Graph
lead_innovation.mechanism: Attach semantic contracts to nodes/tools—inputs, side effects, idempotency, authority, failure modes—and statically/dynamically validate graph composition before execution.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: integrating AI retrieval/memory without turning a general operational database into an overcomplex bundle or duplicating state across systems

lead_innovation.name: Operational-Semantic Twin Index
lead_innovation.mechanism: Derive semantic indexes directly from authoritative document mutations with provenance and transaction linkage so app state and retrieval state cannot silently diverge.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: discovering and controlling agent access as agents proliferate across SaaS data and identities

lead_innovation.name: Agent Relationship Graph Firewall
lead_innovation.mechanism: Build a live graph of agent identities, users, SaaS resources, tools, data sensitivity and observed actions; detect risk from relationship changes and anomalous path expansion, not isolated events.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: defending specialized vector infrastructure as vector search becomes a built-in feature of general-purpose databases

lead_innovation.name: Retrieval Outcome Optimizer
lead_innovation.mechanism: Optimize indexes, filters, rerankers, namespaces and freshness against downstream answer/task success rather than ANN recall in isolation.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: demonstrating measurable capability progress while preserving a safety thesis that cannot rely on ordinary product feedback loops

lead_innovation.name: Capability–Safety Pareto Observatory
lead_innovation.mechanism: Track capability and safety as a joint frontier: every training intervention must show where it moves the Pareto boundary, with automatic quarantine of gains that create disproportionate controllability or misuse regressions.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: scaling Hivemind-style autonomy across platforms and missions while communications, EW, sensor degradation and certification demands grow

lead_innovation.name: Mission Autonomy Evidence Graph
lead_innovation.mechanism: Link every autonomy behavior to simulation cases, flight evidence, software version, sensor assumptions and degraded-mode limits so cross-platform reuse remains auditable.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: learning policies that transfer across very different robots without embodiment mismatch destroying performance

lead_innovation.name: Embodiment Latent Adapter
lead_innovation.mechanism: Factor policy into embodiment-invariant task representation plus a learned morphology/control adapter; measure transfer loss explicitly and use it to choose shared vs embodiment-specific training.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: keeping an integrated developer platform simple while AI apps introduce background jobs, embeddings, agents, permissions and rapidly growing state

lead_innovation.name: Policy-Carrying AI Data Plane
lead_innovation.mechanism: Propagate row-level security identity and policy into embedding generation, retrieval, tool execution and generated artifacts so AI never leaves the authorization model of the source data.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: meeting explosive AI demand while advanced-node capacity, packaging, yield, cycle time, and customer-specific accelerator complexity all constrain output

lead_innovation.name: Yield-to-Workload Feedback Loop
lead_innovation.mechanism: Map field workload failure/performance telemetry back to package/process signatures so yield learning prioritizes defects that most affect delivered AI throughput, not only wafer test pass rates.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: adapting deterministic workflow durability to AI steps whose outputs are nondeterministic, expensive, and model-version dependent

lead_innovation.name: Nondeterminism Envelope
lead_innovation.mechanism: Record semantic outcome constraints and model/tool provenance so replay can accept equivalent AI outcomes while rejecting state-changing divergence.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: turning frontier research and customization into reproducible, inspectable behavior across users and domains

lead_innovation.name: Judgment Replication Fabric
lead_innovation.mechanism: Learn task-specific expert judgment as a portable evaluator/policy layer, then use disagreement between expert-model and base-model behavior to target training data instead of scaling data indiscriminately.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: maintaining broad model choice and training-to-serving integration while proving behavioral fidelity and cost advantage at enterprise scale

lead_innovation.name: Open-Model Fidelity Passport
lead_innovation.mechanism: Publish machine-verifiable serving fingerprints: weights lineage, quantization, sampler defaults, kernel stack, eval deltas, and compatibility constraints for every deployed model variant.

queue.bottleneck_hypothesis: maintaining persistent, causally useful 3D/world state rather than visually plausible but physically inconsistent generation

lead_innovation.name: Persistent World-State Compiler
lead_innovation.mechanism: Convert multimodal observations into a versioned object/geometry/affordance graph whose state must remain consistent across viewpoint, time, interaction, and counterfactual simulation.
